Photograph taken a few steps from the monumental arched entrance of AURELIA GRAND at golden-hour dusk, close to the doors and slightly off-centre. The deep moulded travertine arch frames tall bronze-and-glass double doors, held open, with a glazed fanlight; warm amber light spills out over the honed travertine threshold with its fine bronze inlay lines. Two bronze lanterns with candle flames stand on travertine plinths either side of the doors. Inside, the glowing lobby with a hint of the amber-glass chandelier and the sea far beyond.
